title: Publication review identity and explicit override
description: Set FARMSLOT_GATEWAY and FARMSLOT_PUBLICATION_PROOF_RUN_ID. Read the actual recovered gate without approving or publishing.

live-gate.intent: Prove through run.get that the historical accepted review matches the refreshed package and normal publication is offered, with no publication performed.

identity-and-override.intent: Verify display-only diff changes preserve identity, actual source/mode/binary/untracked changes invalidate it, tampered historical evidence stays stale, and an explicit override is offered without exhausting retries.

override-freshness.cmd: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='approval when current package artifact drifted|approval when selected evidence hash drifted' services/gateway/src/methods/run.test.ts
override-freshness.intent: Prove ordinary publication and the dangerous override both reject changed package artifacts and evidence before resolving the gate.

direct-run-freshness.cmd: TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=apps/command-center/ui/tsconfig.json node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='direct run snapshot|publication gate title' apps/command-center/ui/src/components/runs/run-detail-model.test.ts apps/command-center/ui/src/components/runs/run-detail-decision-renderers.test.ts
direct-run-freshness.intent: Only a successful direct fetch of the selected run in this connection can recover its gate after the bulk run list fails; the bypass label describes any review block rather than only exhausted retries.
